Noah Patel: Candidate Priyanka Verma is onsite Mon May 2. Travel stipend request from recruiter: reimbursement for BART + 1 Uber ride. Interview block 10:00-16:00 PT. Need confirmation of interview kit (whiteboard + markers), backup room if Conf Echo is occupied, and whether we have a laptop loaner.
Sana Ali: I'll handle the stipend pre-approval. Priya, can you take lunch logistics? Candidate indicated gluten-free.
Priya Rao: Yep I got the gluten-free note. I'll order individually packaged meals. OnboardBot can you reserve Conf Echo and Conf Foxtrot as backup?
OnboardBot: Conf Echo reserved 10:00-16:00. Conf Foxtrot tentatively held as backup. Laptop loaner request submitted (IT ticket IT-8920). Stipend pre-approval created (req# 2026-090).
Noah Patel: Great. Also candidate asked about interview feedback timeline. We'll tell them 3-5 business days. Add that to the close-out script.
Sana Ali: I'll add the timeline to the recruiter email template.
Priya Rao: Calendar invite please include signage: "Please check in at reception; badge pick-up."
OnboardBot: Calendar invite sent. Parking code: RDW-33FF. Badge under "Priyanka Verma" at reception. Expense link: https://redwood.example/exp-forms.
Noah Patel: Thanks all, confirm on the invite and ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
